name: project_briefs
description: Project briefs the AI Engineering Organization is evaluated against. Each is the two-field input a real user provides — a name and a description — because 07_System_Architecture.md specifies that as the only onboarding.

cases.name: Hospital Management System
cases.description: A platform for managing patients, appointments, billing, doctors, and hospital operations.
cases.notes: The scenario named in 13_Demo_and_Pitch.md. Regulated domain, several interacting entities, obvious access-control obligations.

cases.name: College ERP
cases.description: A system for managing students, courses, enrolment, attendance, grades, and fee collection.
cases.notes: Listed as an alternative in 13_Demo_and_Pitch.md. Similar shape to the hospital case, different domain vocabulary — checks the organization is not pattern-matching on one brief.

cases.name: Event Booking Platform
cases.description: A platform where organisers publish events and attendees browse, book, and pay for tickets.
cases.notes: Two distinct user roles with different journeys, and a payment path — exercises whether the Product Manager separates them.
